scientific_integrity: Self-contained scalar and projector proof; exact-rational finite replay; earlier general graph-multiplier results not claimed as novel; no claim to independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Completed linear steps on unweighted connected complete multipartite graphs only; negative P4 asymptotic, odd-stage large-step obstruction; historical priority not independently certified.
title: An all-order parity law for Gauss–Legendre heat steps on complete multipartite graphs
